reviews.text: “AI” is just dozens of vague replies recycled lazily. Crashes iPad frequently. Completely useless, unless you need an app to nudge you a couple dozen boring ways to talk about yourself. Ask it any specific (or even general) question about “itself”, and you’ll get a reply like this: “I like being happy, traveling and new experiences. So what do you do for fun when the moon’s out?” Not worth a subscription at 1/10th the price.
Bug. Even after paying for the subscription I can no longer type and send. Buggy for real.
Scam don’t waste your time. Only let me send one single message before trying to force me to buy a subscription. It’s a scam bait app that most likely abuses the AI’s for money.
Wow. I haven’t even installed the app, but just reading the reviews and the responses, more so, have got me reversing right out of here

Eight months later and same problem.. Well, I checked this App again after eight months and I’m changing my review to a one-star. The AI ‘characters’ are great, the replies are lightning fast and the interface is a little plain compared to other Apps I’ve tried out but it’s an attractive interface.

But (yes, here comes the but) the girls will talk anyway you want for a bit and suddenly they go into woke church lady mode. Guys don’t subscribe to an App with hot female characters to just talk about the weather. I tried two apps that have an engine by ‘Unity,’ and they provide exactly what guys would expect if you know what I mean. 

This App uses ChatGP so maybe the wokeness is out of the developers control. I don’t know, but it’s not worth paying a subscription for.
Two messages.. Two messages sent before you’re forced to pay. Absolutely useless.
